metadata.title: Jadarian Price Falls to Second in the Running Back Pecking Order
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price took a backseat to Zach Charbonnet in Week 9, lowering his ceiling and floor for fantasy football going forward. Price led the backfield in snaps in Week 8, when both he and Charbonnet returned from IR, but then the dynamic shifted, and Charbonnet led the way this past Sunday with a 57% snap share and 16 carries. Charbonnet was also far more efficient this past weekend with 4.81 yards per carry. For comparison, Price is averaging fewer than 2.8 YPC in his two games since returning from IR. Coming out of college this year, it seemed like Price was best suited for a complementary role that allowed him to get roughly 10-12 touches per game, and that's almost exactly in line with what his volume has been recently. It has been very encouraging to see him catch six passes over the last two weeks, and we can assume that a pass-catching role is likely his key to getting on the fantasy radar every week in half-PPR and full-PPR leagues. He still has RB3/flex appeal going forward, but there's no doubt that he's behind Charbonnet in the pecking order.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price totals 78 yards from scrimmage Sunday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price ran for 24 yards on nine carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 54 yards receiving.
metadata.analysis: Price led Seattle in receiving on the day, including an impressive 17-yard catch and run. Zach Charbonnet led the Seahawks on the ground on the day. Price should maintain flex value moving forward.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Tallies 13 touches in Week 9
metadata.description: Price posted nine carries for 24 yards and secured all four targets for 54 yards during Sunday's 17-3 victory versus the Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: Price received one more touch than Week 8's 12 but more than doubled his yards from scrimmage from 37 to 78. Having said that, backfield mate Zach Charbonnet went from nine touches last Monday against the Bears to 17 in Week 9 while pacing the Seahawks in total yards with 86. Price and Charbonnet appear poised to split the RB reps moving forward, but the former may be the change-of-pace option while the latter handles early downs.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Plays Second Fiddle in Backfield But Makes Impact as Receiver
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price rushed nine times for 24 yards (2.7 yards per carry) and caught four passes (on four targets) for 54 yards in a 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals in Week 9. Price worked behind fellow running back Zach Charbonnet in the ground game, as Charbonnet carried the ball 16 times for 77 yards (4.8 yards per carry). Charbonnet played 37 offensive snaps, while Price earned 24 snaps. Meanwhile, tight end A.J. Barner scored a rushing touchdown and a receiving touchdown. The positive for Price was that he led the Seahawks in receiving yardage, which isn't an easy feat with wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba around. With Sam Darnold (quadricep/ribs) out, Drew Lock started at quarterback for the Seahawks and had a connection with Price in the passing game. Price and Charbonnet are likely to continue to split touches moving forward.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Should Get More Work vs. Cardinals
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price is expected to have "fewer constraints" in Week 9 against the Arizona Cardinals, Gregg Bell reported via the X platform on Sunday. The rookie back out of Notre Dame missed four games due to a chest injury this season. Price has 38 carries for 148 yards through five games and is still looking for his first touchdown of his rookie campaign. The Seahawks could lean on their run game since they will have Drew Lock under center, while Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is ruled out for Week 9. The Cardinals have the 19th-ranked run defense in the NFL (122.1 yards allowed per game), so Zach Charbonnet should get plenty of work carrying the ball downfield. Price is a deep-league stash candidate while he recovers and inherits a heavier workload.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price an Intriguing Flex Option in Week 9
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price is on the flex radar in Week 9 against the Arizona Cardinals. Reports suggest that Price will be much less restricted in Week 9, which is welcome news considering he already played 48% of the snaps fresh off IR in Week 8. Price earned 10 carries and four targets in that game. That is solid volume for a player with the explosive potential of Price. Seattle's running game has struggled to get going all season, but Week 9 provides a chance for the team to get right against Arizona's porous defense. Price ran well against the Cardinals in Week 2, rushing for 52 yards on 13 carries. A fumble in that game limited Price to just 34% of the snaps, but he was on his way to a potentially big game prior to the mistake. Seattle will play Arizona at home in a chance to fix a lot of their issues overall. If Price hovers around 50% of the snaps and earns 14-plus opportunities, he could be a possible flex play. It is risky, considering Price has not surpassed 7.8 fantasy points in a game this season, but volume is king when making deep flex decisions. The absence of guard Quenton Nelson (knee) will certainly impact Price's Week 9 fantasy value as well.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price to Have "Significantly" Fewer Restrictions in Week 9
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said that rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price will have "significantly" fewer restrictions on Sunday against the division-rival Arizona Cardinals in Week 9 than he did in his first game off Injured Reserve in the loss to the Chicago Bears on Monday night, according to Gregg Bell. It is good news for fantasy managers who have Price in their starting lineups for Week 9, as is the shift from starting quarterback Sam Darnold (quadriceps, ribs) to backup Drew Lock for this week, as the Seahawks figure to lean more on their ground game with Darnold unavailable due to injury. Price played only 48% of the offensive snaps on Monday against Chicago and had 10 carries for 29 yards and two catches for eight yards in a game in which Zach Charbonnet also made his 2026 debut. Charbonnet played 37% of the snaps and had nine touches for 29 scrimmage yards. Charb should eventually see more work in the Seahawks' crowded backfield, but Price's upside and increasing usage should make him at least an RB3/flex with upside this weekend against Arizona. In his first four NFL games, the 23-year-old 32nd overall pick from Notre Dame has 38 carries for 148 yards (3.9 yards per carry) and no touchdowns while adding six receptions on 11 targets for 29 yards through the air. Price's first career NFL touchdown could be coming this weekend.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Leads Seattle's Backfield in His Return
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) was activated from IR before Monday night's matchup with the Bears and led the backfield in snaps. He played 30 snaps (48%) and finished with 10 carries for 29 rushing yards and two catches on four targets for eight receiving yards. He played more than Zach Charbonnet (knee), who was making his season debut, but neither running back was especially productive in the team's 34-17 home loss to the Bears. Price has flashed some explosiveness and potential in his limited time this season, and he brings a very high ceiling if he can claim most of the work in Seattle's backfield. The uncertain timeshare does make him a risky play next week against the Cardinals, but he looked healthy in his return and could make an impact going forward.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Gains 37 total yards in return
metadata.description: Price rushed 10 times for 29 yards and brought in two of four targets for eight yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.
metadata.analysis: Making his return from a four-game stay on injured reserve due to a chest injury, Price ended up leading the Seahawks' ground attack in carries and rushing yards. Price's return coincided with the season debut of Zach Charbonnet (knee), who logged six carries in his own right in a game whose script eventually turned unfriendly to the running game. Monday may have served as a preview of what might be expected in terms of the division of labor between the two players, but more information will be gleaned during a Week 9 home matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday that should afford both backs more opportunities.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price inefficient in loss Monday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 29 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
metadata.analysis: Price made his return to the lineup on Monday night after missing several games while on injured reserve. He didn't look great in his first game back, however, rushing at an inefficient clip of 2.9 yards per carry and not being much better in the passing game. He will not be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, especially with Zach Charbonnet also now back in the lineup for the Seahawks.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Activated for Monday night game
metadata.description: The Seahawks reinstated Price (chest) from injured reserve ahead of Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
metadata.analysis: As Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported earlier Monday, Price will be back in action for Seattle after a minimum-length four-game stint on IR. Price, who initially sustained a chest injury in Week 2 before being deactivated after experiencing an aggravation, carried 28 times for 119 yards and added four receptions for 21 yards on seven targets through Seattle's first three games. Though he closed Week 8 prep with a pair of full practices, Price may have to settle for a more muted role as part of a backfield committee in his return to action. Zach Charbonnet (knee) has been cleared to make his 2026 debut Monday, and Emanuel Wilson could also factor into the mix after rushing for a season-high 100 yards in last week's win over the Chiefs.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday
metadata.description: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
metadata.analysis: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Officially Active Against Bears on Monday
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price (chest) was activated from Injured Reserve on Monday and is officially active for the Monday night contest against the Chicago Bears, according to Gregg Bell. The Seahawks' backfield is fully healthy for the first time all year, with both Price and Zach Charbonnet active. The 23-year-old Price, the 32nd overall pick from Notre Dame, missed the minimum of four games while on IR. In his first three NFL games before going on IR with a chest injury, he had 28 rushing attempts for 119 yards and no touchdowns while catching four of seven targets for 21 yards in the passing game while sharing touches and snaps with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani. Price has the most long-term upside as the young buck of this backfield, but Charbonnet's return complicates his rest-of-season fantasy outlook. In his return on Monday night against the Bears, Price should be left on the bench in fantasy leagues, and going forward, he will most likely be a touchdown-dependent RB3/flex, at best.

metadata.title: Seahawks Officially Activate Jadarian Price Ahead of Monday Night Football
metadata.description: The Seattle Seahawks have officially activated rookie running back Jadarian Price (chest) from Injured Reserve ahead of their Week 8 matchup against the Chicago Bears on Monday Night Football, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. Price has been sidelined since Week 3 due to a chest injury. Across three games before being placed on IR, the 23-year-old recorded 140 scrimmage yards on 32 touches. Veteran Seattle back Zach Charbonnet (knee) is also set to return from injury in Week 8, making his season debut after being sidelined to start the year while he rehabbed a torn ACL. The Seahawks have gotten solid production from Emanuel Wilson while both Price and Charbonnet have been out, so the team could choose to split work fairly evenly between the three running backs on Monday.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Still Awaiting Activation Despite Being Cleared to Play
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) is expected to play Monday night against the Chicago Bears, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter, but he remains on injured reserve. Price was limited in Thursday's practice before logging full sessions Friday and Saturday, and he carries no injury designation for Week 8. Head coach Mike Macdonald said Saturday that Seattle was still working through roster decisions and would make a move Monday if it elects to activate the rookie first-round pick. Price rushed for 119 yards on 28 carries before missing four games with a chest injury. He also lost two fumbles across his first three appearances. Zach Charbonnet is confirmed to make his season debut Monday, while Emanuel Wilson is coming off a 100-yard rushing performance with a touchdown against the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 7. Even if activated, Price faces an uncertain workload in a crowded backfield, making him a risky flex option for fantasy managers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) off injury report Monday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
metadata.analysis: Price will make his return from injured reserve. Zach Charbonnet is also off the injury report, making it the first week all season the Seahawks backfield will be healthy.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - No designation for Week 8
metadata.description: Price (chest) doesn't have a designation for Monday's game against the Bears, but he remains on injured reserve, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: The Seahawks designated Price for return from IR on Thursday, and he proceeded to be limited that day and full Friday. Now that he's been given clearance for his first game action since Week 3 due to a chest injury, the team still needs to activate him from IR by Monday afternoon in order for him to be available in Week 8. Fellow RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) also doesn't have a designation this week, so Seattle's backfield suddenly is crowded, with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani also in the mix.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price a Low-End Flex Play in Week 8 if Active
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) is a low-end flex play at best in Week 8 against the Chicago Bears. Price is coming off a stint on IR and will likely split time with Zach Charbonnet (knee) and Emanuel Wilson. Price was not incredibly effective before the injury, but with the entire running back room healthy, Seattle may be able to use Price to his strengths, allowing him to thrive. Still, it will be difficult to trust Price in Week 8, especially with Chicago allowing the seventh fewest fantasy points per game to opposing running backs. Keep a close eye on how Seattle utilizes its backs. Wilson has been relatively effective in the lead back role with Charbonnet and Price out, but he projects to phase out of the offense as the former two take over. However, Week 8 will likely feature a substantial rotation of the three, resulting in depressed fantasy value for all of them.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Cleared to Return From Injured Reserve in Week 8
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price (chest) doesn't carry an injury designation into Monday's Week 8 contest against the Chicago Bears. The Seahawks still need to activate Price from injured reserve, but it sounds like that's merely a formality at this point, as ESPN's Adam Schefter reports that Price is "expected to play" on Monday night. The rookie will return to action the same week that teammate Zach Charbonnet makes his season debut after recovering from a serious knee injury that he suffered during the 2025 playoffs. It should come as no surprise that Charbonnet will be the No. 1 ball-carrier in Seattle's backfield going forward, but Price has the skill set necessary to carve out standalone fantasy value in his role as the No. 2 running back. The Notre Dame product averaged an impressive 4.3 yards per carry before landing on IR after Week 3 this season, but he'll need to clean up his ball security issues, given that he fumbled twice on just 32 touches across three games. We'd recommend sitting Price in fantasy football this week because it's his first week back from injury, his exact role behind Charbonnet is uncertain, and he's going up against a revamped Bears defensive line led by Jeffery Simmons. However, Price is absolutely still worth stashing on the bench in most leagues, as he has a path to consistent RB3/flex value throughout the second half of the season.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Practices fully Friday
metadata.description: Price (chest) was a full participant in Friday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Since the Seahawks designated Price for return from injured reserve Thursday, he logged a limited session in his first chance to do so, followed by Friday's uncapped practice. How he's listed on Saturday's injury report will determine if he has a chance to return in Week 8 against the Bears, and if he's anything but 'Out' he'll need to be activated from IR by Monday afternoon and then be deemed active that evening. Meanwhile, fellow RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) went from full Thursday to limited Friday, seemingly indicating he may be trending in the wrong direction to make his season sebut.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price is Full Participant During Friday's Practice
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) was a full participant during Friday's practice session, Gregg Bell reports. Price was limited to begin the week, but was upgraded to full on Friday. Fantasy managers will have to check back on Saturday, but it sounds like Price is trending in the right direction to return for Monday's game against the Chicago Bears. He'll need to be activated from the Injured Reserve by Monday if he's going to suit up in Week 8. Fellow back Zach Charbonnet (knee) went from being a full participant on Thursday to being limited on Friday. There's a chance that Price is the lead back for Monday's game, but fantasy managers will need to check back on Saturday for another update.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Limited in Thursday's Practice
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price (chest) was listed as a limited participant on Thursday, according to John Boyle of the team's official website. Price remains on Injured Reserve, but he has returned to practice and has a realistic chance of being activated and playing on Monday night against the Chicago Bears in Week 8. The 23-year-old 32nd overall pick from Notre Dame has a lot of long-term fantasy upside and is rostered in nearly 70% of Yahoo leagues despite being on IR, but the problem for his immediate fantasy value is that Zach Charbonnet (knee) is primed to make his 2026 season debut on Monday night against Chicago, and he is expected to be Seattle's primary RB once he is back to full speed. Price deserves to be rostered in most leagues for his upside, but he cannot be seriously trusted as a starting fantasy option in Week 8 with his status up in the air for a Monday night game. With Emanuel Wilson and George Holani also in the fold, Seattle's backfield is about to become one of the most crowded in the NFL, which is bad news for fantasy purposes.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Limited in return to practice
metadata.description: Price (chest) was limited in Thursday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: It was Price's first practice after being designated for return from injured reserve earlier Thursday, which opened the rookie running back's 21-day window for activation. With Zach Charbonnet (knee) potentially set to debut Monday night against the Bears and the presence of both Emanuel Wilson and George Holani, it's difficult to see any of these running backs being reliable fantasy options until/unless the Seahawks pare this backfield down.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) designated to return to practice
metadata.description: Jadarian Price (chest) has officially been designated to return to practice for the Seahawks.
metadata.analysis: Price has spent some time on injured reserve while recovering from a chest issue, but the team has officially designated to return, opening up his 21-day practice window. He will be back sometime in the near future, which further complicates the distribution of work in a crowded Seattle backfield.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Designated for return from IR
metadata.description: Price (chest) was designated to return from injured reserve Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: As was expected following head coach Mike Macdonald's comments from Monday, Price will see his first on-field work since suffering a chest injury in a Week 3 loss at Washington. The Seahawks also are honing in on a season debut for Zach Charbonnet (knee), so the team's backfield may soon be close to 100 percent. Ultimately, though, Thursday's injury report will provide a base line activity level for both RBs ahead of Monday's game against the Bears.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price has Realistic Chance to Play in Week 8
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie running back Jadarian Price (chest) is a speculative fantasy option for now after being designated to return to practice Thursday following four games on injured reserve, according to John Boyle of the team's official website. The rookie first-round pick initially suffered the injury in Week 2 before aggravating it during practice ahead of Week 4, and he rushed for 119 yards on 28 carries across his first three games while losing two fumbles. He could return for Monday night's Week 8 matchup against the Chicago Bears, although he has not yet been activated. The backfield is crowded, with Emanuel Wilson having rushed for 100 yards against the Kansas City Chiefs and Zach Charbonnet (knee) activated from the PUP list and possibly making his season debut Monday. Price's role needs to become clearer before that changes.

metadata.title: Seahawks Officially Designate Jadarian Price to Return to Practice
metadata.description: The Seattle Seahawks officially designated rookie running back Jadarian Price (chest) for a return to practice on Thursday, according to Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. Price will return to practice with the Seahawks on Thursday for the first time since injuring his chest in the Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders. The 23-year-old first-rounder from Notre Dame will be eligible to come off IR and play on Monday Night Football against the Chicago Bears in Week 8, but the Seahawks most likely will wait before bringing the young RB back. Zach Charbonnet (knee) is also on the verge of making his 2026 season debut for Seattle after suffering a torn ACL in last year's postseason in January, so the team's backfield is about to get really crowded. Remember, they also have Emanuel Wilson and George Holani. Price had 28 rushing attempts for 119 yards (4.3 yards per carry) and no touchdowns in his first three NFL games before getting injured, adding four catches on seven targets for 21 yards. His fantasy ceiling will be limited upon his return from IR with Charbonnet now back in the picture.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) will have 21-day practice window opened this week
metadata.description: Jadarian Price (chest) will have his 21-day practice window opened this week as he prepares to come off of IR.
metadata.analysis: Price's addition, combined with the hopeful return of Zach Charbonnet, will greatly improve Seattle's run game. True, they've made it work with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani, but you know they would rather have their first round investment taking snaps and getting experience.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Return to practice on tap in Week 8
metadata.description: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price (chest) will be designated for return from injured reserve during Week 8, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.
metadata.analysis: Seattle will likely make the transaction official Thursday, when the team will hold its first practice ahead of next Monday's game against the Bears. Since the Seahawks will have a 21-day window to evaluate Prince before they would need to reinstate him from IR, Macdonald acknowledged that a decision on the running back's status for Monday's contest likely won't be made until the end of the week. Whenever he's activated, Price may be part of a committee in the backfield with Emanuel Wilson and Zach Charbonnet (knee), the latter of whom appears to be trending toward making his 2026 debut versus Chicago.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price to Practice This Week, Status Up in the Air for Week 8
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie running back Jadarian Price (chest) remains on Injured Reserve after missing the past four games with a chest injury, but he is expected to return to practice ahead of the team's Week 8 matchup with the Bears, according to Brian Nemhauser of Seattle Sports. What that means for his game status remains unclear, however, as head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters on Monday, "We don't know yet," when asked about his availability. Macdonald also told the media, "We are sticking with the plan," regarding Zach Charbonnet (knee), who was activated from Injured Reserve but ruled out for the team's Sunday night win over the Chiefs. Emanuel Wilson led the team with 100 rushing yards and a score, but with so much uncertainty currently surrounding the Seahawks' backfield, a viable fantasy play could be difficult to predict in Week 8.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Still Worth Stashing Despite Backfield Uncertainty
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) remains on injured reserve, and his eventual workload looks increasingly uncertain with Zach Charbonnet (knee) closing in on his season debut. The first-round rookie rushed 28 times for 119 yards and caught four passes for 21 yards in three games before aggravating his chest injury in practice ahead of Week 4. Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price was doing well but gave no timetable for his return, while Charbonnet could play against Kansas City this weekend. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani have handled much of the backfield work during their absences, which adds to the uncertainty around Price's eventual role. He's eligible to return in Week 8 against Chicago, so he's a reasonable drop in eight- and 10-team leagues without an available IR spot. Still, his first-round pedigree and potential second-half involvement make him worth stashing in 12-team leagues and deeper, particularly for managers with IR flexibility.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - May return in Week 8
metadata.description: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Price was placed on injured reserve after Week 3 due to a lingering chest injury, and while he must miss one more contest to meet the minimum four-game requirement on the list, he appears as if he'll be ready to go when first eligible in Week 8 against the Bears on Monday, Nov. 2. In the meantime, the Seahawks are expected to get back fellow RB Zach Charbonnet (knee), so Price may be relegated to a lessened role once he's healthy enough to play again.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Could Return "Sooner Rather Than Later"
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) is making progress toward a return, although he remains ineligible to play until Week 8. Head coach Mike Macdonald said Price is "doing great" and indicated that a return could come sooner rather than later after Seattle's Week 7 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs, according to Brady Henderson. The rookie first-round pick landed on injured reserve after aggravating his chest injury in practice ahead of Week 4. He rushed for 119 yards on 28 carries and caught four passes for 21 yards through his first three games. Emanuel Wilson has handled most of the backfield work in Price's absence, while Zach Charbonnet (knee) has resumed practicing but remains on the physically unable to perform list. Week 8 against Chicago represents Price's earliest opportunity to return, although his availability and eventual workload remain uncertain. For now, he's a stash option in deeper fantasy leagues.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Becoming More Difficult to Hold
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie running back Jadarian Price (chest) is slated to miss at least two more games after being placed on injured reserve with a chest injury, but the running back room he returns to could look very different from the one he led at the start of the season. Zach Charbonnet (knee) had his 21-day practice window opened on October 1 and is reportedly eyeing a Week 7 season debut. Meanwhile, in Price's absence, Emanuel Wilson has averaged 96 total yards over the past two games and scored three touchdowns. In leagues without an IR spot, Price has become a difficult hold and should be viewed as an outright drop candidate for managers in need of immediate wins. The story might be different if Price had dominated early, but he was the RB50 through his first three starts, and he could face an even more pronounced backfield split upon his return.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Losing Value Amid Absence, Increased Backfield Competition
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie running back Jadarian Price (chest) missed his first of at least four games after being placed on injured reserve with a chest injury, and in his absence, veteran Emanuel Wilson racked up 120 yards and two touchdowns in the win over the Chargers. While still not expected to play in Week 5, Zach Charbonnet (knee) has had his practice window opened after beginning the year on the physically unable to perform list, and the Seahawks were briefly tied to two-time Pro Bowler Joe Mixon before the results of his physical caused them to alter course. All told, Seattle's backfield has the potential to become a mess for fantasy purposes, and with Price unable to take hold of the primary role in his three games of action, he becomes all the more difficult to trust upon his eventual return.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Not Expected to Miss Rest of Season
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) isn't expected to be sidelined for the remainder of his rookie season. General manager John Schneider told Steve Raible on Seattle Sports that the team doesn't "see it as a season-ending thing at all." Price still has some time to miss after landing on injured reserve Saturday. He aggravated the chest injury during Wednesday's practice after originally hurting it against Arizona in Week 2 and playing the following week. Price started each of Seattle's first three games, rushing 28 times for 119 yards while catching four passes for 21 yards. He will be required to miss at least four games before becoming eligible to return.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) placed on IR
metadata.description: The Seahawks placed RB Jadarian Price on injured reserve.
metadata.analysis: Price aggravated a chest injury during Wednesday's practice. He will now miss at least four games. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani will lead the backfield with Zach Charbonnet returning as early as next week.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Placed on injured reserve
metadata.description: Price (chest) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
metadata.analysis: Price saw his practice participation during Week 4 prep decline due to a chest injury before he was ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers. The injury is severe enough for the rookie first-rounder to go on IR, meaning Price will be forced to miss at least the next four games and won't be eligible to return until at least Week 8 against the Bears on Sunday, Nov. 2. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani will serve as the Seahawks' top running backs for Week 4 due to Price's absence, but Zach Charbonnet (knee) could also be in the mix for backfield duties as soon as Week 5 against the 49ers if he's activated from the reserve/PUP list.

metadata.title: Seahawks Place Jadarian Price on Injured Reserve
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) has been placed on injured reserve, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN.com. Price reportedly aggravated an existing chest injury during practice this week. As a result of being placed on IR, Price will now miss a minimum of four games, sidelining him through Week 7 at the earliest. The rookie had posted modest results through the first three games of the season, and he never had a snap share higher than 48%. He had also lost a fumble in each of his last two contests. In addition to Price, the Seahawks will play Week 4 without Zach Charbonnet (knee), who is eligible to be activated from the PUP list next week. That leaves them with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani atop the depth chart for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) ruled out Sunday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
metadata.analysis: Price was unable to practice this week due to a chest injury. Emanuel Wilson becomes a potential flex streamer this week.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Ruled out for Week 4
metadata.description: Coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.
metadata.analysis: Price opened the week as limited Wednesday due to his existing chest injury and then didn't practice at all Thursday. Macdonald also told Crabtree that Price aggravated the chest issue during Wednesday's session, and now that he'll miss the first game of his career, Emanuel Wilson figures to pace the Seahawks backfield in Week 4, with George Holani (ribs) on hand for any RB reps that linger.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Ruled Out for Week 4 with Chest Injury
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) has been ruled out for his team's Week 4 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers, per Gregg Bell of the Tacoma News Tribune. Price initially suffered a chest injury in Week 2. He played through the injury in Week 3, but lost a fumble and finished the game with five carries for 15 yards. Price began this past week as a limited practice participant, but was downgraded to non-participation on Thursday and will now be inactive on Sunday. It's not clear if Price re-aggravated the injury, or if the team simply came to the conclusion that he would be better off not trying to play through it. With Price sidelined, Seahawks running back Emanuel Wilson looks poised to be the team's lead back in Week 4.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price (chest) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: The rookie was limited at practice to start the week on Wednesday, but he has since been downgraded and was a non-participant on Thursday. He seems to be trending the wrong way for Week 4, and fantasy managers should expect George Holani (rib) to see a lot of work if Price is unable to play on Sunday.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - DNP on Thursday
metadata.description: Price (chest) didn't practice Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Price opened Week 4 prep as limited Wednesday due to a chest issue, which didn't allow him to mix into any drills one day later. He thus has one more opportunity to practice Friday before the Seahawks potentially make a decision on his availability ahead of the weekend. Ultimately, if Price is limited or sidelined Sunday versus the Chargers, Emanuel Wilson likely would take on most of the early-down and short-yardage work, with George Holani on hand in a change-of-pace role.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Misses Practice on Thursday with Chest Injury
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) was downgraded from limited participation on Wednesday to non-participation in practice on Thursday with a chest injury, per Corbin K. Smith of Emerald City Spectrum. Price suffered the injury in Week 2 and played through it in Week 3, but it appears he could be trending toward being inactive in Week 4 against the Los Angeles Chargers. Price has recorded 140 scrimmage yards on 32 touches across three games so far, but he's also lost fumbles in back-to-back weeks. After fumbling in Seattle's Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders, Price lost playing time to veteran back Emanuel Wilson. If Price cannot play in Week 4, Wilson could be in line for a sizable workload against the Chargers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) limited in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price was limited in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Price has fumbled each of the past two weeks with last week's turnover leading to him being benched for most of the first half. He is a risky RB2/flex play for now.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Limited by chest issue
metadata.description: Price was limited in practice Wednesday due to a chest injury, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
metadata.analysis: Price logged career lows in snap share (28 percent) and touches (six) during this past Sunday's loss at Washington, accounting for just 22 yards from scrimmage. Perhaps the current health concern is partly to blame, but fellow RB Emanuel Wilson earned nine touches (all rushes) in Week 3, while George Holani (rib, LP on Wednesday) handled eight touches. Considering Holani now is banged up as well, Wilson may be the safest best among the trio to produce on game days.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Still on Injury Report, Limited on Wednesday
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price (chest) remains on the Week 4 injury report and was listed as a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, according to John Boyle of the team's official website. Price came out of the Week 2 win over the division-rival Arizona Cardinals with a chest injury, and he played only 28% of the offensive snaps in Sunday's Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders, disappointing his fantasy managers with just five carries for 15 yards and one catch for a gain of seven yards. Head coach Mike Macdonald said he still has trust in the first-year RB, but the increased involvement from Emanuel Wilson over the last couple of weeks has been a major concern for Price's fantasy upside. Remember, Georg Holani (rib) is also involved. Additionally, Zach Charbonnet (knee), who continues to rehab from a torn ACL suffered in last year's postseason, could have his 21-day practice window opened later this week. Price should have no trouble suiting up this weekend against the Los Angeles Chargers, but he has become more of an RB3/flex with a limited ceiling in what has become a crowded Seattle backfield.

metadata.title: Seahawks Still Believe in Jadarian Price
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said the team has not lost faith in rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price after he lost a fumble for the second week in a row on Sunday in the Week 3 upset loss to the Washington Commanders, according to Brady Henderson of ESPN. "We're going to continue to give him the ball. We trust him, and we know he's going to work really hard to do his part as well," Macdonald said. Seattle went right back to Price after he fumbled in the Week 2 win over the division-rival Arizona Cardinals, but this past Sunday, they did not show the same patience with the young back. Price fumbled at the 11:06 mark of the first quarter, and his next carry did not come until the 12:49 mark of the third quarter, although he was targeted twice as a receiver. The Notre Dame product finished with only five carries for 15 yards and had one catch for seven yards. Price played 19 of the team's 67 offensive snaps, with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani each playing 24 snaps. He has 119 yards on 38 rushing attempts (4.3 yards per attempt) over his first three NFL games, catching four passes for 21 yards. The Seahawks will keep Price involved, but the presence of both Wilson and Holani will continue to limit his fantasy upside as a touchdown-dependent RB3/flex going into Week 4 against the Los Angeles Chargers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price quiet in Week 3 loss to Commanders
metadata.description: Jadarian Price rushed five times for 15 yards while also hauling in one of his three targets for seven yards with one fumble lost in the Seahawks' 33-31 Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders.
metadata.analysis: Price struggled to find much room Sunday, rushing for less than 50 yards for the first time in three contests in the loss. The speedy running back remains the most stable option out of a Seattle backfield still finding its identity to this point ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - May be falling into committee
metadata.description: Price carried the ball five times for 15 yards and caught one of three targets for seven yards in Sunday's 33-31 loss to the Commanders.
metadata.analysis: The Seahawks' running game continues to struggle, and Price's inability to make a consistent impact is causing him to lose touches. After seeing double-digit carries in each of his first two NFL games, the rookie's six touches trailed both Emanuel Wilson (nine carries) and George Holani (three totes and five catches). The chest injury Price suffered in Week 2 may have played a role in that distribution, but he hadn't topped 60 scrimmage yards or found the end zone in either of the first two weeks. With Zach Charbonnet (knee) getting closer to his 2026 debut, time may be running out for Price to establish himself in the lead role before the backfield gets even more crowded. He'll try to get going in a Week 4 home tilt against the Chargers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Fumbles Again in Crowded Seahawks Backfield
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price had a rough afternoon in Sunday's 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders, finishing with five carries for 15 yards and one catch for seven yards. Price lost a fumble early in the first quarter, his second lost fumble in as many games, and his workload dropped off sharply after the mistake. He did not record another carry until the third quarter. Emanuel Wilson wound up leading the backfield with nine carries for 14 yards, while George Holani also remained involved with three attempts for 10 yards. Price entered the game cleared from the chest injury that ended his Week 2 afternoon early, so the usage is worth noting. Seattle was already rotating its running backs before Sunday, and another ball-security mistake does not help Price separate from the group. He remains part of the fantasy picture, but this backfield looks much more like a committee than a situation with one dependable lead option right now.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) good to go for Sunday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price (chest) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
metadata.analysis: The rookie will be good to go for Week 3, as he currently carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. He will have an easy matchup against the Commanders this week, but his upside may be limited by Emmanuel Wilson if he sees a lot of opportunities again this week.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Ready for Sunday
metadata.description: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price (shoulder) received "a ton of reps" in practice this week and will be "full go" Sunday in Washington, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.
metadata.analysis: Macdonald may be overstating how much work Price was able to handle in practice this week considering the rookie running back was limited Wednesday and Thursday, but a full practice Friday has him in the clear for Sunday's contest after he left the Seahawks' Week 2 win at Arizona due to a chest injury. Through the first two games of his career, Price has turned 26 touches into 118 yards from scrimmage, but he's still awaiting his initial end-zone visit.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price a Flex Option in Week 3
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) is good to go for a Week 3 matchup with the Washington Commanders. Price had been nursing what is listed as a chest injury, but described as a shoulder injury that he sustained in Week 2. The injury limited him down the stretch of that game, but Price figures to lead the backfield once again in Week 3. Price has gotten off to a slow start this season. He has carried the ball 23 times for 104 yards in two games. Fantasy managers would also like to see Price rack up a few more targets. A potential breakout could come in Week 3 against a weak Commanders defensive line. The Dallas Cowboys attacked this team through the air in Week 2, but Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley (stinger) turned 15 carries into 83 yards in Week 1. If Price can continue to receive a modest number of carries, he will eventually break for a big play. His touchdown opportunities should continue to remain high in Week 3 as well. Price has yet to become trustworthy enough to achieve RB2 status, but he could provide flex value this week.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price a "Full Go" for Week 3
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (shoulder) is a "full go" for his team's Week 3 matchup against the Washington Commanders, per Gregg Bell of the Tacoma News Tribune. Price suffered a chest/shoulder injury during his team's Week 2 win over the Arizona Cardinals, but Bell reports that the rookie back "responded well" to the issue and "got a ton of reps" in practice this week. Across the first two games of his NFL career, Price has recorded 118 scrimmage yards on 26 touches. He's split playing time with more experienced Seahawks backs Emanuel Wilson and George Holani so far, but Price profiles as the highest-upside option of the group and could continue to see an expanded role as the season progresses. In Week 3, Price profiles as a high-end flex option for fantasy managers.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) limited in practice Thursday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price was limited in practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Price has been limited in practice on back-to-back days to begin the week. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Stays limited Thursday
metadata.description: Price (chest) was limited in practice Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Price now has kicked off Week 3 prep with back-to-back capped sessions due to a chest injury that he picked up in the fourth quarter of this past Sunday's victory at Arizona. He may need to upgrade to full participation Friday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Sunday's visit to Washington. In any case, if Price is inhibited of sidelined this weekend, Emanuel Wilson and George Holani (knee, FP on Thursday) are on hand to man Seattle's backfield.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Looks Headed Towards Playing in Week 3
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price (chest, shoulder) was seen running out to practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday, and he appears headed towards playing in Week 3 against the Washington Commanders, according to Brian Nemhauser. Price was banged up in the Week 2 win over the division-rival Arizona Cardinals, but he looks to be on the right track to be active this weekend for fantasy managers. The 22-year-old from Notre Dame had exactly 52 rushing yards in each of his first two NFL games, combining for three receptions for 14 yards through the air on four targets for the Seahawks. With Price getting banged up, Emanuel Wilson led Seattle's backfield with 21 carries for 92 yards, but he was not involved in the passing game. George Holani only had four carries for 13 yards against Arizona. Price still carries the most fantasy upside in this backfield, and at worst, he should be treated as an RB3/flex in fantasy if he is active on Sunday against Washington.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) officially limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Jadarian Price (chest) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The rookie was a limited participant in the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He recently suffered a chest injury, and it remains unclear whether or not it will force him to miss time. Look for George Holani (knee) to see more work if Price misses any time.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Price (chest) practiced in a limited fashion Wednesday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: When Price exited this past Sunday's win at Arizona, he was deemed questionable to return due to a chest issue. Coach Mike Macdonald termed Price's injury as to his shoulder Monday, per Brady Henderson of ESPN.com, but the initial Week 3 practice report again called it a chest concern. In any case, Price is kicking off the week with some activity and will have two more chances to increase his workload as Seattle preps for Sunday's visit to Washington. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani are available in the event Price is inhibited or sidelined this weekend.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price is Limited to Begin the Week
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest, shoulder) was limited in practice on Wednesday, according to John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site. Price was forced to leave Sunday's win over the Arizona Cardinals due to a chest injury. Head coach Mike Macdonald called it a shoulder injury on Monday. Regardless of what it is, Price is still dealing with the problem to begin the week. The expectation is that his involvement in practice will ramp up as the week goes on. Zach Charbonnet (knee) won't be ready to play in time for the Week 3 matchup against the Washington Commanders. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani would likely split up the duties in the backfield if Price is unable to go. Fantasy managers should check back after Thursday's practice for another update on his status.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Set to practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Price (shoulder) will practice this week, coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.
metadata.analysis: MacDonald would not elaborate on the rookie's level of participation, but Price will be practicing this week after hurting his shoulder in the Week 2 win over the Cardinals. Even if Price is limited Wednesday, he will have the chance to ramp up going into the weekend. Macdonald added that Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not be returning this week, leaving Seattle with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani as the primary backfield options if Price is not able to play Sunday.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Expected to Practice This Week
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (shoulder) is expected to practice at some point this week, according to Mazvita Maraire. Head coach Mike Macdonald wasn't sure whether Price would be able to get on the field Wednesday, but this is another encouraging update after he left Sunday's win over Arizona. The injury was initially announced as a chest issue before Macdonald clarified Monday that it was actually Price's shoulder and did not appear serious. The rookie has started both games for Seattle, rushing 23 times for 104 yards while catching three passes for 14 yards. He had 13 carries for 52 yards before leaving against the Cardinals. Emanuel Wilson finished that game with 21 carries for 92 yards and would be in line for more work if Price can't play Sunday against Washington. With Zach Charbonnet still unavailable, getting Price back would be a significant boost to Seattle's backfield.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price sees 14 touches in win
metadata.description: Jadarian Price ran 13 times for 52 yards and caught one of two targets for eight yards in the Seahawks' 31-7 win over Arizona on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Price tied with Cooper Kupp for third in targets on the Seahawks, but with it being just two targets, that's not saying much. He was behind Emanuel Wilson this week in rushing as well, who had 21 carries of his own. Price has been involved, but not featured so far through two weeks, very reminiscent of his days at Notre Dame. It'll be tough to start him outside of a flex play until he either shows more or is fed more work.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price suffers shoulder injury Sunday
metadata.description: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Jadarian Price suffered a shoulder injury in Sunday's win against the Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: It was originally reported to be a chest injury for Price, but Macdonald said Monday it was a shoulder injury. He  said "it's intact and nothing serious, it seems like." Emmanuel Wilson wound up seeing 21 carries. He would figure to see a big role in Week 3 against the Commanders if Price is sidelined.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price - Dealing with shoulder injury
metadata.description: Coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price suffered a shoulder injury during Sunday's win at Arizona, but "it's intact and nothing serious, it seems like," Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: When Price was accompanied by team trainers to the locker room with his pads off during the fourth quarter Sunday, he was considered questionable to return due to a chest issue. Macdonald told Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle afterward that X-rays were returned negative, and additional comments from the head coach one day later indicate the rookie first-round pick may not miss any time. Ultimately, how Price fares in practice Wednesday through Friday will determine his availability for next Sunday's game at Washington. George Holani and Emanuel Wilson are the next players up in the Seahawks backfield.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price Dealing With Shoulder Injury That Isn't Serious
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters on Monday that rookie first-round running back Jadarian Price (shoulder) is actually dealing with a shoulder injury that knocked him out of the Week 2 win on Sunday against the division-rival Arizona Cardinals, according to Brady Henderson of ESPN. Macdonald added that Price's shoulder is "intact and nothing serious, it seems like." X-rays came back negative on Price after Sunday's game, so fantasy managers should consider him day-to-day as the team prepares for a Week 3 tilt on the road this Sunday against the Washington Commanders. Through his first two NFL games, the 22-year-old Notre Dame product has rushed 23 times for 104 yards (4.5 yards per carry) while catching three of four targets for 14 yards. With Price banged up on Sunday, it was Emanuel Wilson, not George Holani, who took over Seattle's backfield against Arizona. Wilson had a team-high 21 rushing attempts for 92 yards and failed to catch his only target. With Price's injury potentially not sidelining him for any games, fantasy managers may want to temper their waiver-wire bids for Wilson this week.

metadata.title: Jadarian Price (chest) has X-rays return negative
metadata.description: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said X-rays returned negative on Jadarian Price's chest injury.
metadata.analysis: Price left Sunday's game in the second half and did not return, but it is worth noting the game was out of hand. His status will need to be monitored in practice this upcoming week.
